tableSchema.notes: Table with a list of all government coalitions in Danmark for the time frame covered by the nordatlantisk-ft dataset (starting 2004).

columns.name: cabinet
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Name
columns.description: ID for the cabinet, usually named after the head of government

columns.name: wikidata_id
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Wikidata ID
columns.description: Wikidata Identifier for the entity representing each cabinet

columns.name: bloc
columns.dc:title: Political Bloc
columns.description: String identifying whether the government coalition belongs to the left (red) or right (blue) bloc of Danish politics, or is formed across blocs (across)

columns.name: type
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Type
columns.description: String identifying whether the government is a single-party government (single_party) or a coalition government (coalition)

columns.name: DK_A
columns.dc:title: Socialdemokratiet (A) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Socialdemokratiet (A) was part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_B
columns.dc:title: Radikale Venstre (B) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Radikale Venstre (B) was part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_C
columns.dc:title: Det Konservative Folkeparti (C) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Det Konservative Folkeparti (C) was part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_F
columns.dc:title: Socialistisk Folkeparti (F) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Socialistisk Folkeparti (F) was part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_I
columns.dc:title: Liberal Alliance (I) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Liberal Alliance (I) was part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_M
columns.dc:title: Moderaterne (M) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Moderaterne (M) were part of the coalition government

columns.name: DK_V
columns.dc:title: Venstre (V) Party Coalition Membership
columns.description: Boolean indicator whether Venstre (V) was part of the coalition government
